name: Malt-O-Meal Crispy Rice / Rice Chex
whyItWorks: Puffed white rice has 0g insoluble fiber and dissolves into harmless starch the second it hits liquid. Rice Chex is also certified gluten-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Let soak in cold lactose-free or almond milk for 60-90 seconds with a drizzle of honey or maple syrup.
